current.title: Round 70 DELIVERED — the agent brain round (0.70.0)
current.detail: Research-driven (the round's own prompt audit + the OSS agent study; no new owner field report). The model now knows its world, follows conventions, and verifies before claiming done: every turn's prompt states the real OS + release, the real shell, the date, and the git branch/dirty state (TERMINAL teaches only the real platform's syntax); AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.override/CLAUDE.local.md auto-load in a documented order with source markers and @file imports (16K/32K caps) — plus a project-init skill that writes that AGENTS.md from codebase analysis; the four overlapping planning sections merged into one five-phase loop (PLAN→EXPLORE→ACT→VERIFY→FINISH; registry 23→20 ids) with the Codex dirty-worktree rule, the verify-after-edit contract, and the path:line communication contract; the ACI round made tool feedback honest (run_command keeps head 32KB + tail 32KB with a middle-omission marker, read_file is cat -n with offset/limit pagination and honest empty/EOF messages, todo_write carries the planning discipline); skills became a system (file-based .acute/skills + ~/.agents/skills with the Agent-Skills standard and DB-row precedence, 8 builtins incl. browser-use and project-init, STICKY bodies that survive the whole task at a 60K budget, the computer-use skill gated on the master switch, agent.skills wired after being dead data since R61) — all while the prompt SHRANK 22,460→20,156 chars. Verification: 2177 root tests in 126 files, all green (agent-core 1275/63 files, frontend 890 unchanged, e2e 12/12 in-suite against the fresh build), lint/typecheck clean, build green, license audit CLEAN (134 deps, no dependency changes). The seven new skill bodies are construction-pinned — the owner's real tasks are the live gate.
